name: Leafroll
summary: A mint glass HR dashboard: staff, hours you drag to set, a time off board and payroll
about: A seven-page people, hours and pay app for a remote team, built from frosted mint glass over a drawn backdrop. The home page grows a team leafroll where every leaf is a person. Set each day's hours by dragging bars, decide time off on a drag-and-drop board, and run payroll through review, approve and pay steps with payslips.
how: Use the floating icon rail (a bottom bar on phones) to switch pages; hover an icon for its name.
On Home, watch the leafroll grow and click any leaf to open that person; switch the payroll trend between 6M and 12M.
On Staff, flip between cards and a table, search, filter by team, and add, edit or remove people.
On Hours, pick a person and drag the top of a day's bar to set the hours (or use the arrow keys); totals, overtime and pay value update.
On Time off, drag a request card into Approved or Declined, or use its buttons; holiday balances change and you can undo.
On Pay, review lines and add bonuses, pass the checks, approve, then pay and open any payslip.
